name: ReFuel Your Fun Program
description: Lower-cost, reusable alternative to single-use 1 lb. propane cylinders
fullDescription: San Mateo County's ReFuel Your Fun program helps residents switch from single-use 1 lb. propane cylinders to reusable, refillable ones sold and refilled at participating local stores, saving money and reducing hazardous waste.
whatTheyOffer:
- Reusable 1 lb. propane cylinders (about $25) that last up to 10 years
- Refills for about $3, compared to about $6 for a single-use cylinder
- Participating stores sell, refill, or exchange cylinders
- Locations include Hassett Ace Hardware stores, Sports Basement Redwood City, and markets in La Honda, Loma Mar, and Pescadero
- Free disposal of old cylinders through the County Household Hazardous Waste program (by appointment)
howToGetIt:
1. Buy a reusable propane cylinder at a participating store
2. Bring your empty cylinder back to a participating store to refill or exchange
3. Reuse the cylinder for camping and grilling
4. Dispose of old single-use cylinders through the County Household Hazardous Waste program
keywords: ReFuel Your Fun, propane, reusable propane cylinder, refill, camping, grilling, San Mateo County, zero waste, hazardous waste
